focus: Medical and health programs for high school students

programs.name: High School Research Immersion Program
programs.costDetail: No program fee listed. $4,800 stipend.
programs.deadlineNote: Open now. Closes Dec 4, 2026. All materials, including the teacher recommendation, must arrive by then.
programs.dates: June 1 to July 24, 2027. 8 weeks, 9 AM to 5 PM, 40 hours a week. Poster exhibition on July 24, 2027.
programs.eligibility: Current juniors at a high school in the Memphis-Shelby County area or nearby counties in Tennessee, Mississippi or Arkansas. Age 16 or older. GPA 3.0 or higher. U.S. citizen, U.S. national or permanent resident.
requirements: Parent or guardian permission if selected

programs.name: High School Volunteers Program
programs.costDetail: No fee listed. This is a volunteer role.
programs.deadlineNote: Session 1 applications are only taken Nov 30 to Dec 7, 2026. Orientation is in mid December. Applications for the June to August session are taken Apr 5 to 12, 2027. Applications for the session starting in September 2027 are taken July 5 to 12, 2027.
programs.dates: Session 1 runs February through May 2027. Session 2 runs June through August 2027. One weekly shift of at least 2 hours for the whole session.
programs.eligibility: High school students who are age 14 or older.
requirements: Online application during the open week
Background studies with photo and fingerprints
Weekly shift for at least one full session

programs.name: KEYS Research Internship
programs.costDetail: Free. No application fee. You earn 3 units of MCB credit. Limited campus housing for students from outside the Tucson area. Aid is available for costs like meals, parking and transportation.
programs.deadlineNote: Open now since Nov 2, 2026. Closes Dec 17, 2026. Your recommenders must finish their forms by Jan 7, 2027, or your application will not be considered. Interview news by mid-February. Offers by the end of March.
programs.dates: June 7 to July 23, 2027. 1 week of training, then 6 weeks in a University of Arizona lab, 35+ hours a week. You must be available for the whole program.
programs.eligibility: High school students age 16 or older by June 7, 2027. U.S. citizen or permanent resident who has lived in Arizona at least one year. For students interested in bioscience, biomedicine or data science.
requirements: Online application with three essay questions
Contact info for two recommenders, one a science teacher
Recommenders fill out the KEYS form. Letters are not accepted.
Final presentation at the Research Showcase

programs.name: High School Summer Research Experience in Cancer (SURE-CAN)
programs.costDetail: No fees listed; living allowance for a few students
programs.deadlineNote: Opened Oct 1, 2026. Closes Jan 1, 2027. School recommendation form also due Jan 1.
programs.dates: June 28 to Aug 6, 2027 (full time, 40 hours a week)
programs.eligibility: Juniors (class of 2028), 15+ by program start; live and go to school in Erie, Niagara, Cattaraugus or Chautauqua County, NY; U.S. citizen or permanent resident
requirements: Recommendation form from a school counselor or registrar

programs.name: BrainSTORM Mentorship Program
programs.location: Online or in person (New York, NY)
programs.costDetail: No fee listed
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Nov 2026. Due Jan 1, 2027 at 11:59 PM ET. Decisions by Mar 1, 2027. Up to 20 students. Monthly online brain talks are open to all high schoolers, no application.
programs.dates: About one year with a research mentor. Starts July to September 2027 and ends June 2028 with a poster day.
programs.eligibility: High school students anywhere in the U.S. who will be in grades 10 to 12 next school year (2027-28)
requirements: Online application with your research interests and mentor choice
Personal statement, 150 words max, as a PDF
No AI use allowed on the application
Proof of health insurance if accepted

programs.name: Summer Science Research Program (SSRP)
programs.costDetail: Free, with no application fee. OMNY transit card provided. Need-based stipends for some. Housing not provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Opened Oct 12, 2026. Application and recommendation letter due Jan 4, 2027 at 5 PM ET. Late applications are not considered. Interviews in March, decisions in late April.
programs.dates: June 21 to Aug 5, 2027 (full time, about 35 hours a week)
programs.eligibility: High school juniors or seniors, 16+ by June 21, 2027; no GPA minimum

programs.name: KP LAUNCH High School Internship
programs.costDetail: Paid job: $25 per hour
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Nov 16, 2026. Closes Jan 8, 2027 at 5 PM PT.
programs.dates: June 14 to July 30, 2027. Full time, Monday to Friday.
programs.eligibility: Current high school students or Class of 2027 seniors, ages 16 to 19 by June 1, 2027. Class of 2026 grads with no college may also apply. Juniors and seniors get priority. Must live in a Northern California KP service area and be allowed to work in the U.S. Dependents of KP employees and physicians cannot apply.
requirements: Work permit if you will still be in high school in fall 2027
Drug screen and health checks if hired
Background check if you are 18 or older when hired

programs.name: researcHStart
programs.host: University of Chicago Medicine and partners
programs.costDetail: Free. Taxable $3,000 stipend. No housing or transportation provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Not final yet. UChicago runs the program and has not posted 2027 dates. Its page still says applications are closed. The UIC Cancer Center site page lists Jan 11, 2027 and links a 2027 application form, but that page also shows last year's program dates. In 2025 it was due Jan 20, with both recommendations due the same day.
programs.dates: 8 weeks, 35 to 40 hours a week. Usually the second full week of June to the first week of August. In 2026 it ran June 15 to Aug 7. 2027 dates not posted yet.
programs.eligibility: High school juniors or seniors when you apply. Age 16+ by the start of the program. Live in Illinois or Lake County, Indiana. Must commit to all 8 weeks.
requirements: One online application for all UChicago Cancer Center pathway programs
Two recommendations, one from a teacher
To work at the UIC site, rank UIC as your first choice

programs.name: Agress Summer Health Corps
programs.costDetail: Free volunteer program. No pay. Lunch meal card and free parking provided.
programs.deadlineNote: The 2027 dates are not posted yet. Last year the application was open only from Dec 15, 2025 to Jan 15, 2026, and late forms were not accepted. Expect about Dec 15, 2026 to Jan 15, 2027.
programs.dates: Summer 2027, about 6 weeks. Last year it ran July 7 to Aug 13, 2026, Monday to Thursday, 9 AM to 2 PM.
programs.eligibility: Massachusetts residents over the age of 16 who are in 10th or 11th grade when they apply. Must have reliable transportation to Boston. Past participants cannot apply again.
requirements: Two references, one from a teacher, counselor or advisor
Proof of MMR, varicella, Tdap and Hepatitis B shots if accepted

programs.name: Summer Research Experience (SRE)
programs.costDetail: No program fee listed. No stipend or housing.
programs.deadlineNote: Opened Oct 15, 2026. Closes Jan 15, 2027 at 11:59 PM. After you submit, enter your two recommenders in the applicant status portal.
programs.dates: June 2 to July 14, 2027. 6 weeks working with cancer researchers.
programs.eligibility: High school students interested in biomedical science, especially cancer research. You must be 16 by the start date for lab projects. Students under 16 can apply for bioinformatics or community-based research projects. Priority goes to students from Richmond, Columbia and Aiken counties.
requirements: Two recommendation letters, at least one from a teacher or counselor
Photo ID and proof of health insurance

programs.name: STARS Summer Research Program for Students
programs.costDetail: Free. Students are paid a stipend. The amount is not listed.
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Nov 16, 2026. Closes Jan 22, 2027, per the STARS 2026-27 student calendar. The program page lists Nov 21 to Jan 20 with no year, so apply by Jan 20 to be safe. Required materials are not posted yet.
programs.dates: 8 weeks in summer 2027 in a biomedical research lab. Non-residential. No clinical or shadowing work. Exact dates not posted yet.
programs.eligibility: High school juniors who are 16 or older by June 1, 2027. U.S. citizens, U.S. nationals or those eligible to work in the U.S. Aimed at North Texas students. Students with prior research experience are not eligible.
requirements: Present your research at the end of the summer
Give talks about your research at your own school

programs.name: Young Scientist Program (YSP) Summer Focus
programs.costDetail: No program fee listed. $4,800 stipend before taxes. Free Metro transit pass. Parking not provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Opened Nov 2, 2026. Due Jan 25, 2027. Recommendation letters due Feb 1, 2027. Interviews Mar 6 and 7, 2027. Decisions in April 2027.
programs.dates: June 7 to July 30, 2027, in person, 40 hours a week. Orientation June 2 to 4, 2027. You can miss no more than 3 days.
programs.eligibility: Grade 11 students at a high school in the Greater St. Louis area of Missouri or Illinois. Must live in the St. Louis metro area. For students with no previous research experience.
requirements: Two recommendation letters, one from a math or science teacher

programs.name: NIH Summer Internship Program (SIP)
programs.location: Bethesda, MD and other NIH campuses
programs.costDetail: Free. NIH pays a monthly stipend based on your school level. No housing provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Open now. Closes Jan 26, 2027 at noon ET. References due Feb 2, 2027 at noon ET.
programs.dates: Full time in summer 2027, between May 10 and Aug 31
programs.eligibility: High school seniors who graduate before the internship and turn 18 by Sept 30, 2027. If you are still 17 on June 1, 2027, your home must be within 40 miles of an NIH campus. U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
requirements: Contact NIH researchers yourself to ask about a spot

programs.name: Summer High School Research Internship
programs.costDetail: Free. This is a paid internship with a stipend.
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Dec 4, 2026.
programs.dates: June 1 to Aug 6, 2027 (full time, 10 weeks)
programs.eligibility: Juniors or seniors, age 16, minimum 3.5 GPA
requirements: Two required essays, plus one optional essay

programs.name: RITMS Summer Research Program
programs.host: Rutgers Institute for Translational Medicine and Science
programs.costDetail: Tuition-free. Day program only, no housing.
programs.deadlineNote: Due Feb 1 each year. Foreign nationals apply by Jan 1. Applications are reviewed as they come in starting in November, so apply early.
programs.dates: 8 weeks, third week of June to second week of August
programs.eligibility: Age 16+ by the start date. Entering grade 10, 11 or 12. GPA 3.0+ or all A's and B's in math and science.
requirements: Two references, one from a science or math teacher
Proof of U.S. citizenship or permanent residence if selected
Parent consent, waiver and conduct forms

programs.name: Inspiring Careers in Mental Health Internship
programs.costDetail: No fee listed
programs.deadlineNote: Estimated. UTSW's page says applications open in late September and are due in early February, but it does not give the 2027 date or an apply link. Students are picked in March.
programs.dates: Two weeks in June 2027, online. The exact days are not on UTSW's program page.
programs.eligibility: Rising 10th, 11th and 12th graders and rising college freshmen. That means grades 9 to 12 in the 2026-27 school year.
requirements: Personal essay on why you want to join
Recommendation from your school counselor or homeschool administrator
Statement that you have no felonies

programs.name: HOPP Summer Student Program
programs.costDetail: Free. $1,200 stipend for the summer. Housing and transportation not provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Dec 1, 2026. All materials due by 8:00 AM ET on Feb 5, 2027.
programs.dates: June 29 to Aug 20, 2027
programs.eligibility: Juniors, 16+ by June 2027, 3.5 science GPA, live within 25 miles of MSK in NY, NJ or CT. Must be legally allowed to work in the U.S.

programs.name: Neuroscience High School Virtual Summer Program
programs.costDetail: Program fee: $0
programs.deadlineNote: UCLA posts the real deadline in December 2026. Date based on last year.
programs.dates: Summer 2027, dates posted in December
programs.eligibility: Rising juniors and seniors currently enrolled in high school
requirements: No transcript or recommendation letters needed

programs.name: Summer Student Research Program
programs.costDetail: Free. $3,000 stipend for high school students. No housing provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Expected to open in December 2026. The 2027 cycle will take both high school and college students. Due in February each year. The 2026 deadline was Feb 13, 2026.
programs.dates: About 7 weeks, mid-June to end of July. 2026 ran Jun 15 to Jul 31.
programs.eligibility: Grades 10 to 12, age 16+ by June 1. One year each of math and biology. U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Must be economically, educationally or medically disadvantaged.

programs.name: UPMC Hillman Cancer Center Academy
programs.host: UPMC Hillman Cancer Center and University of Pittsburgh
programs.location: Pittsburgh, PA (one site also has hybrid or remote projects)
programs.costDetail: Free; stipends for some students from groups underrepresented in biomedicine (housing not provided)
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Dec 3, 2026. Closes Feb 14, 2027.
programs.dates: June 14 to July 30, 2027 (tentative, full time)
programs.eligibility: High school students, 15+ by June 14, 2027 (16+ for wet lab sites); seniors OK if not taking college classes during the program

programs.name: STEP-UP High School Research
programs.costDetail: Free. Paid stipend. Housing is not provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Oct 15. High school apps are due Feb 15 at 11:59 PM ET. The site does not list a year, so check before you apply.
programs.dates: At least 8 weeks, 40 hours a week. High schoolers start by the first full week of June. Everyone presents at an in-person research symposium in late July or early August.
programs.eligibility: High school juniors and seniors, age 16+, GPA 3.0+. U.S. citizen, national or permanent resident.
requirements: Online application in the STEP-UP Student Portal
Two letters of recommendation from academic references
Proof of health insurance and ID if accepted

programs.name: UH Future Nurse Academy
programs.location: Northeast Ohio, at one of three sites in the Cleveland area
programs.costDetail: No fee is listed. Meals, materials and rides to field trips are provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Applications open in mid-January 2027 and are due by mid-February, by midnight on the due date. Last year's deadline was Feb 19, 2026. Decisions come in early April.
programs.dates: Two weeks in summer 2027, 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM. Monday to Thursday in week one and Monday to Friday in week two. Sites and dates for 2027 come out in January. Last year's three sessions ran between June 15 and July 31, 2026.
programs.eligibility: High school students entering 11th or 12th grade in fall 2027 who are interested in nursing. No residency rule is posted, but all sites are in the Cleveland area. Rides are listed only for field trips, so plan how you will get to your site.
requirements: Application with all required documents by midnight on the due date
Attend the full two weeks at one site

programs.name: 4-Week Summer Research Exposure Program
programs.host: Wake Forest Institute for Regenerative Medicine
programs.costDetail: No program fee listed. No stipend listed. It is a commuter program.
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Jan 15, 2027. Closes Feb 15, 2027 at 5 PM ET. Decisions by Mar 22, 2027. Parts of the page still show 2026 dates. Go by the 2027 dates at the top.
programs.dates: June 21 to July 16, 2027. Mentors set the schedule. Last year it averaged 20 to 30 hours a week.
programs.eligibility: North Carolina high school students ages 16 to 18. Only 8 to 10 spots.
requirements: Signed agreement and parent consent form
Immunization records and TB skin test if selected

programs.name: Stanford Institutes of Medicine Summer Research (SIMR)
programs.costDetail: Free to attend. $50 application fee, waived if your family earns under $80,000. A few need-based stipends.
programs.deadlineNote: Stanford says the deadline is in late February 2027. The application opens Dec 18, 2026.
programs.dates: Tentatively Jun 7 to Jul 29, 2027
programs.eligibility: Class of 2027 or 2028, age 16+ by the June 2027 start. Must live and attend high school in the U.S. and be a U.S. citizen or green card holder. Bay Area students are strongly favored.

programs.name: Pediatrics Internship Program
programs.costDetail: No tuition; $50 application fee (can be waived); $3,000 stipend if in need
programs.deadlineNote: Based on last year, when it opened Jan 7 and closed Feb 23.
programs.dates: Seven weeks, early June to late July
programs.eligibility: Rising juniors and seniors from 7 Bay Area counties, 16+, GPA 3.0+

programs.name: Health Careers Academy (HCA)
programs.host: University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center
programs.location: Albuquerque and regional sites across New Mexico
programs.costDetail: No program fee listed. Stipend when you finish the program. The amount is not posted.
programs.deadlineNote: Summer 2027 applications are open now. Albuquerque applications are due Feb 28, 2027. Regional sites in the NE, NW, SE and SW regions, Santa Fe Indian School and Taos are due Apr 17, 2027.
programs.dates: A multi-week summer program plus a one-day orientation. Length depends on the site. 2027 dates not posted yet. In 2025 the Albuquerque session ran June 9 to June 20.
programs.eligibility: New Mexico or Navajo Nation residents who are high school sophomores or juniors when they apply. GPA 2.5 or higher. Interest in a health career. Regional sites only take students from certain counties.
requirements: Attend the full program and orientation
Get to your site each day, or have internet for a virtual program

programs.name: Apprenticeship in Medicine (AIM)
programs.costDetail: No program fee listed. Students get a stipend.
programs.deadlineNote: Applications open in late October or early November. MCW says they are due March 1 every year, so expect Mar 1, 2027. Interviews are usually during MPS spring break.
programs.dates: Six weeks, mid June to early August 2027. The AIM page lists a June 21 start. About 40 hours a week.
programs.eligibility: Rising juniors, rising seniors and June graduates, age 16 or older. Must attend a Milwaukee Public Schools, Milwaukee-area charter or private, or nearby suburban high school. Science and math GPA of 2.75 or higher. U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
requirements: Official high school transcript as a PDF
Two online evaluations, one from a high school science teacher

programs.name: DNA Day Essay Contest
programs.costDetail: No entry fee. In 2026, winners got $1,000, $600 and $400.
programs.deadlineNote: Due in early March each year. In 2026, entries opened Jan 9 and were due Mar 4, 2026. That deadline was later extended to Mar 8. 2027 details are not posted yet.
programs.dates: Winners announced in late April.
programs.eligibility: Grades 9 to 12, in the U.S. and other countries. One student per essay. Group essays are not accepted.
requirements: Essay of 750 words or fewer, in English
In-text citations and a reference list
If you use AI tools, note it in your citations
A teacher or school official submits the essay, or a parent for homeschooled students

programs.name: Summer High School Internship Program (SHIP)
programs.costDetail: Free; paid award if you finish; free transit (ORCA) card
programs.deadlineNote: Fred Hutch says 2027 details will be posted in November 2026. Not posted as of Nov 9, 2026. Estimate based on last year's deadline of Mar 13, 2026.
programs.dates: Eight weeks in summer, full time, up to 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday. In 2026 it ran June 22 to Aug 14.
programs.eligibility: Rising seniors, 16+ by start; live in the Greater Seattle area; no out-of-state or international students
requirements: Online application with short essays, 200 words each. There were four in 2026.
Two recommendations through the online form

programs.name: ISPEED in Biomedical Engineering
programs.costDetail: Free: tuition, housing, meals and travel to Baltimore covered. You can apply for a one-time need-based stipend.
programs.deadlineNote: Not posted yet. Johns Hopkins posts application info on the program page about 6 months before the program starts. Date based on last year's March 16 deadline.
programs.dates: Four weeks, late June to late July. Summer 2026 ran June 29 to July 24.
programs.eligibility: 10th or 11th graders. U.S. citizen or permanent resident. At least 15 on move-in day and under 18 on the last day of the program.
requirements: One recommendation (math or science teacher or counselor)
Official transcript sent by your school

programs.name: Stanford Medical Youth Science Program (SMYSP)
programs.costDetail: Tuition-free. Housing and transportation are not provided. No stipend in 2026.
programs.deadlineNote: Last year closed March 23. The 2026 application opened in mid-December. 2027 details are not posted yet.
programs.dates: Five weeks, late June to late July, on campus Monday to Friday
programs.eligibility: Low-income, first-generation high school juniors who live in Northern California. You must live with a family member or guardian during the program.
requirements: Check the site for essays and recommendations

programs.name: Student Research Internship
programs.costDetail: Free. Depending on funding, it may be paid or earn you school credit.
programs.deadlineNote: Estimated from past years. The 2025 deadline was Mar 31.
programs.dates: 10 weeks in summer
programs.eligibility: Age 16+ by the start of the internship. For students interested in genomics or digital health.

programs.name: Eye on the Future Teen Video Contest
programs.costDetail: No entry fee. One winner in each of three categories gets $2,000.
programs.deadlineNote: Entries close in late April each year. The 2026 round ran Jan 12 to Apr 19, 2026. Entries also stop once 300 videos arrive, so send yours early.
programs.dates: Submissions open in mid January. Winners announced by the end of June.
programs.eligibility: Grades 9 to 12 at a high school in the U.S. or a U.S. territory. Enter alone or in a team of exactly three. Cash prizes go to U.S. citizens and permanent residents.
requirements: Video 30 seconds to 3 minutes long, not counting credits
Signed registration form, with a parent signature if under 18
Signed release form for anyone else seen or heard in the video

programs.name: Disease Detective Camp
programs.costDetail: Free to attend. You pay for your own housing and travel to Atlanta.
programs.deadlineNote: The 2026 application is closed. CDC says to check back in January 2027 for 2027 details.
programs.dates: One week in summer, 8:45 AM to 4:00 PM each day. 2027 dates are not posted yet. In 2026 the two sessions were June 22 to 26 and July 20 to 24.
programs.eligibility: Rising juniors and seniors. You must be 16 by the first day of camp.
requirements: Application form from the camp FAQ page
Check back in January 2027 for the full list

programs.name: Public Health Academy Online Summer Course
programs.costDetail: Tuition-free
programs.deadlineNote: CDC posts 2027 info in January 2027. The 2026 deadline was Apr 10, 2026.
programs.dates: One week in June (2026 was June 8 to 12), live class 1 to 3:30 PM ET each day
programs.eligibility: Rising juniors and seniors, 16+ on the first day of the course
requirements: Application from the course FAQ (check in January 2027)
Finish daily assignments on time to earn the certificate

programs.name: Perry Outreach Program
programs.location: One-day events at hospitals and universities across the U.S.
programs.costDetail: Free. Lunch is provided.
programs.deadlineNote: Each program day has its own deadline, usually about one month before it. Check the program list for sites near you.
programs.dates: One Saturday, 8:30 AM to 3:30 PM. Programs run September through June at sites across the U.S., 40 students each.
programs.eligibility: High school students from all backgrounds.

programs.name: Clinical Neuroscience Immersion Experience (CNI-X)
programs.costDetail: $2,100 online or $3,850 in person per session; aid can cut the fee by up to 90%
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Dec 15, 2026. Closes Feb 1, 2027. Decisions in early March 2027.
programs.dates: Two weeks. Online: June 7 to 18 or June 21 to July 2, 2027. In person: July 5 to 16 or July 19 to 30, 2027
programs.eligibility: Ages 14 to 18; in high school or just graduated; open to all, including international students
requirements: Ask for financial aid in the application
In person: arrange your own housing and travel

programs.name: Aspiring Scientists Summer Internship Program (ASSIP)
programs.costDetail: $25 application fee. Tuition was $1,299 for 2026, paid only if you accept a spot. 2027 tuition will be posted in November 2026. Both can be waived for financial need, such as free or reduced lunch.
programs.deadlineNote: Opens Dec 7, 2026. Closes Feb 12, 2027.
programs.dates: Summer 2027. In 2026 it ran 8 weeks, full time, from Jun 18 to Aug 12. 2027 dates will be posted in November 2026.
programs.eligibility: High school and college students, age 15+ by the first day. Age 16+ for labs with biological or chemical hazards. You can take part for up to two summers.
requirements: STEM courses, GPA and work or volunteer experience
No transcript or recommendation letters at the first review

programs.name: Summer Medical Academy
programs.costDetail: $3,000 last year, plus a $50 registration fee. Limited need-based scholarships.
programs.deadlineNote: Applications open Dec 1, 2026. Estimate based on last year's deadline of Feb 20, 2026 at 3 PM PT. Last year's flyer said Feb 10, so apply early.
programs.dates: Session 1: Jun 21 to Jul 2, 2027. Session 2: Jul 12 to 23, 2027.
programs.eligibility: Ages 15 to 19 in June 2027. Must have finished 9th grade, up to the summer after 12th grade.

programs.name: Penn Summer Academies (Biomedical Research)
programs.costDetail: 2027 tuition not posted yet. Penn's tuition page still shows the 2024 price of $9,700. $100 application fee. Free for some Philadelphia public school students.
programs.deadlineNote: Rolling admission until full. Last year, apps opened Dec 1 and programs usually filled by March. Apply early.
programs.dates: 3 weeks, mid-July to early August. Last year ran Jul 11 to Aug 1, 2026.
programs.eligibility: Current 9th to 11th graders with a 3.5+ GPA and one year of high school biology
requirements: Third essay if English is not your first language

programs.name: NYLF Medicine & Health Care
programs.costDetail: Starts at $4,499 for the 8-day program. You can hold your spot for $499 on the payment plan. The plan has a $99 nonrefundable deposit fee.
programs.deadlineNote: No set deadline. Spots are first come, first served until sessions fill. Payment plans are open Oct 1, 2026 to Apr 30, 2027. After that, you pay in full.
programs.dates: 8 days in June or July. 2027 dates not posted yet.
programs.eligibility: High school students in grades 9 to 12
requirements: Pay in full, or hold your spot for $499 on the payment plan
